name: att3-tailprefill-ctx4096
command: for r in 1 2 3; do for D in 0 1; do for B in fast att2 att4; do echo "== $B kv $D round $r"; ./engine/pinfer_run_$B -m models/qwen35-0.8b-q4k-headq4k.pq -t 4 -n 2 -c 4224 --ids-file tmp/att3/tail4096_64.ids --spec 0 --kv-dtype $D --no-warmup --load-state tmp/att3/s4096_kv$D.bin --bench 2>/dev/null | grep -E "RESULT|^generated" | sed "s/^generated/gen/"; done; done; done
